summary.text: Rafael Anchía is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 103 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He took office on January 11, 2005, and is an attorney at Haynes and Boone, LLP.

paragraphs.text: Rafael Anchía is an attorney with Haynes and Boone, LLP, and previously worked as an attorney for Patton Boggs LLP.
He has been a guest lecturer at St. Mary's University School of Law, an adjunct professor at Texas Tech University School of Law and a visiting professor at Tulane University Law School.
He is a member of the Oak Cliff Lions Club and has chaired the National Association of Latino Elected and Appointed Officials.
Anchía advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Melanie Medley-Thomas in the general election.
In the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the House Administration, Energy Resources, Redistricting and State Affairs committees.
